Delicious food/coffee- excellent service
Dec 2024 • Solo
I popped in to eat something before leaving for the airport, and was pleasantly surprised by the quick service and the food. I ordered avocado on toast, which was, firstly a visual delight, and tasted superb - coming as it did with two poached eggs and a tasty beetroot sauce. My first ever coconut coffee was delicious. 
Definitely a must visit restaurant in Hanoi. 
Big thanks to DK and Thai.
